title: Show HN: Reactor Atlas
summary: Reactor Atlas is a platform being developed by a nuclear engineer-turned-entrepreneur who previously built a successful blockchain company. The project appears to leverage the founder's nuclear simulation background and HPC expertise to create a resource or tool related to nuclear reactors, emerging as the founder pivots from blockchain services (which are declining due to AI competition) to more specialized scientific ventures.
problem_solved: Making nuclear reactor data, simulations, or information more accessible and actionable for the industry or general audience.
why_valuable: Combines deep nuclear engineering expertise with modern software practices to fill a gap in nuclear energy information infrastructure, especially as AI disrupts traditional software consulting.
